title: Discord Join Voice By Name
description: Join a Discord voice channel by server/guild name and optional channel name. Use this for requests like 「memoサーバーの通話に入って」 by passing guild_name as memo and channel_name only when the user specifies one. Requires approval.

guild_name.description: Discord server/guild name to match, for example memo

channel_name.description: Optional voice channel name. Leave empty if the user only asked for the server's call.
